blank.name: Essential Cotton T-Shirt
blank._note: Replaced RU0010 on 14 Sep 2026. The RU0010 was 180 gsm / 5.3 oz, LIGHTER than the Comfort Colors 1717 it was meant to improve on, had no Small, and carried a 'sizing is smaller than standard' warning on its own product page. RT0063 fixes all three: heavier, full S-3XL range, no sizing warning. Costs $3.00 more per blank.
blank._source: Read from the live Tapstitch product page, 14 Sep 2026.

print_area._note: REAL print area, from Evan reading the Tapstitch editor 14 Sep 2026, replacing the placeholder canvas. editor_px is what the editor states and editor_dpi is the resolution those pixels are quoted at. ASSUMED 150, NOT CONFIRMED: Tapstitch does not publish it, and 150 is the only reading under which the design fits at all (at 300 the widest back area is 6.9in across and a 12in temple is impossible). It also lands within half an inch of the 14.98in Printify area this catalogue printed on for a year. width_px and height_px are the editor numbers doubled, so the exported PNG is 300dpi at final size rather than 150; the aspect ratio is identical to the pixel, so 'upload, centre, full size' places it the same way. If the editor turns out to quote 300dpi, change editor_dpi and every inch in the layout halves: nothing else needs touching.

front_print_area._ink_note: Both numbers are measured on the logo's ink, not its file frame. The logo PNG carries about 2.4% transparent padding across and 6.4% down, so the old frame-width rule printed a 5.86in logo where the config said 6.0in.

_naming_note: Was 'Essential Temple Tee' (Evan's 16 Sep 2026 call to keep it while the crew and hoodie were renamed). EVAN, 16 Sep 2026: 'Essential Heavyweight Temple Tee', which is what the live Salt Lake product had already been renamed to by hand. THE MISMATCH WAS NOT COSMETIC: scripts/tapstitch_run.py blocks a row whose intended title already exists on the store, which is the guard against publishing a second copy of a live product, and it compares TITLES. While this config said 'Essential Temple Tee' and the live tee said 'Essential Heavyweight Temple Tee' the two could not match, so the runner reported the already-live Salt Lake tee as ready to build and would have published a duplicate. Caught in plan mode before anything ran. A rename on the store now has to be mirrored here for that guard to keep working. The older note's rationale, that titles were what the store's addresses were built on and replacements inherited them, is FALSE and was disproved 16 Sep: Shopify builds a new product's address from its title and ignores whatever address just came free. See docs/decisions.md, 16 Sep.

fulfillment._note: Evan, 14 Sep 2026: every line moves to USA fulfillment. Production 1-2 days and shipping 3-5 days, so 4-7 days to a customer's door against 10-17 from the international center. shipping_method is null because the US center's own service name was not read off the product page; the international options (Special Line, Special Line Pro, International Express) do not apply. Confirm the service name and the technique in the first editor session.
fulfillment._technique_note: DTG as read off the international product page. The two fleece blanks print DTF from the US center, so confirm which technique the RT0063 uses there before the copy is written.

costs_usd._all_in_note: EVAN'S FIGURE, 14 Sep 2026, and the one to trust. Includes the blank, printing both sides, shipping, custom neck tag, hangtag, order insert, and payment gateway fees. Revised for USA fulfillment. The per-shipment line items that used to sit here were international rates and are gone rather than left to mislead; nothing below sums to all_in_per_unit.
costs_usd._blank_note: International list price, 14 Sep 2026. The US price was not read; the two fleece blanks price identically either way.

_colorways_note: tapstitch is the name in their editor; shopify is what the storefront shows, renamed after publish. ink is which art file that colorway prints. Every colorway in the current range is dark, so everything prints white and no black art file is needed; a light colorway added later needs ink 'black'. UNVERIFIED against the blank's own swatch names. These are the names Evan gave, and the tee's were carried over from the RU0010 it replaced, so RT0063 may spell one differently ('Dark Grey', 'Wine', and so on). A mismatch fails quietly: rename_option_value finds nothing to rename and the storefront keeps Tapstitch's name, and the colour reorder cannot find the colour it was told to lead with. Confirm the exact spellings in the editor during the first live session.
_preview_color_note: Review-sheet background only, approximating Black, the colour this line opens on. Not a colour spec and nothing prints from it.
_spacing_note: Evan, 14 Sep 2026, superseding the earlier spacing: the temple and the location line are simply centred in the print file, vertically and horizontally, with the temple ink spanning no more than 12.0in at its widest point, the location line 0.7in of INK tall (not box), and the top of that line 0.5in below the temple's lowest ink. There is no top or bottom margin requirement any more, which is why both are 0.0 here: they were measured off the Printify back-stack layout, where the logo sat at the bottom of the back, and centring made them meaningless. They were also the only thing stopping tall temples reaching full width. The retiring Printify profiles keep 0.6 and 2.5 in spacing_defaults.json, untouched.
_costs_history_note: Was $20.57 under international fulfillment, a figure worked out while the blank was still the RU0010 and therefore about $3.80 light for the RT0063. The $19.57 supersedes both and is measured on the blank and the fulfillment actually in use.
